Super Productivity: an open-source todo & time-tracking app with timeboxing, Pomodoro, Kanban boards, and GitHub/GitLab/Jira/Nextcloud Deck integrations.

No account required, and it doesn't collect data. Store your data via WebDAV, Nextcloud, Dropbox, or its own encrypted, self-hostable SuperSync server.

Runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS and the web.


Details & alternatives: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/superproductivity.html

#OpenSource #Productivity #Privacy #SelfHosted
